mapper.insert: INSERT INTO message (from_user_id, to_user_id, content, type, related_id, is_read, create_time) VALUES (#{fromUserId}, #{toUserId}, #{content}, #{type}, #{relatedId}, 0, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.from_user_id as fromUserId, m.to_user_id as toUserId, m.content, m.is_read as isRead, m.create_time as createTime, -- 对方用户ID：如果我是发送者则取接收者，否则取发送者 CASE WHEN m.from_user_id = #{userId} THEN m.to_user_id ELSE m.from_user_id END as partnerId, u.nickname as partnerNickname, u.avatar as partnerAvatar, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM message m2 WHERE m2.to_user_id = #{userId} AND m2.from_user_id = CASE WHEN m.from_user_id = #{userId} THEN m.to_user_id ELSE m.from_user_id END AND m2.is_read = 0) as unreadCount FROM message m LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = CASE WHEN m.from_user_id = #{userId} THEN m.to_user_id ELSE m.from_user_id END WHERE m.id IN ( SELECT MAX(m3.id) FROM message m3 WHERE m3.from_user_id = #{userId} OR m3.to_user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY CASE WHEN m3.from_user_id = #{userId} THEN m3.to_user_id ELSE m3.from_user_id END ) ORDER BY m.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT m.*, u.nickname as from_nickname, u.avatar as from_avatar FROM message m LEFT JOIN user u ON m.from_user_id = u.id WHERE (m.from_user_id = #{userId} AND m.to_user_id = #{partnerId}) OR (m.from_user_id = #{partnerId} AND m.to_user_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY m.create_time DESC, m.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}
